Return to Grandpa Winston and you will receive 1 Yggdrasil Seed .

Return to Grandma Vira with the items she requested and she will give you a Yggdrasil Seed . Note: Currently, upon completion of the quest she will not take the bread and grapes from you.

dossiers.guide_title: Continental Guard Quest (Resurrection of Satan Morroc)

wiki_steps.text_excerpt: In Morroc , Talk to the Continental Official (176, 103), and tell him that you want to volunteer.

dialogue_examples.source_argument: "On behalf of the Continental Guard, I thank you for your efforts. Now, let me see if I've received any news from Headquarters that you should know..."

wiki_steps.text_excerpt: Talk to Chief Balrog in Morroc (159, 113) and tell him that you want to join the Continental Guard. He'll ask you to bring him 50 Glacial Heart and 30 Live Coal .

dialogue_examples.source_argument: "You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morroc in order to suppress Satan Morroc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather."
"I'm sorry, but I'm too busy checking through all these applications for future Continental Guards to greet you adventurers one by one."

dossiers.assurance: NPC source-code facts only; quest identity/state transition is unverified

wiki_steps.text_excerpt: Go inside the library, and talk to the Library Part-Timer, who says you can find the book in the room on the right side of the hall in the bestseller corner.
Talk to the Library Part-Timer again, who tells you that the old news articles are found in the room opposite that of the first.
Return to the Juno Library and talk to the Library Part-Timer, who tells you where you can find the book. Before you can find it however, you black out again.

dialogue_examples.source_argument: "People should learn to put away books after pulling them out."
"All these books piled up in the cart make me feel so frustrated, you know? Sigh..."
